Interesting: in T10 (the previous line clear), only the vertical dots turned g (the merged dot at 12-15 + V5 at 36-39), and the horizontal arm was empty at that point (all horizontal dots had already been merged into the corner, which was consumed). Now: the horizontal line was cleared, and all dots on the board (including the vertical V2, V5) turned g. So the rule is: line clear → all dots on the board freeze (turn g) + key awarded.
So the game is: each round, perform a line clear (a merge that lands at the end of the arm with a dot on the opposite side of the selected dot). This freezes all dots and awards a key. Then click the key icon → next round (dots reset).
Goal: probably collect a fixed number of keys (e.g., 3) to clear the level. The level number stays at 1... maybe the level number only goes up after N keys, or maybe each round of level 1 is independent.
The key icon is currently displayed. Click it to advance to the next round (same as T12). This worked before (the board reset).
So the loop is: line clear → click key icon → repeat. How many times? Unknown — probably 3 keys to clear level 1. Let's just keep going: click the key icon now.
Actually wait — should I click the key icon, or is there another action (ACTION7)? Last time I clicked the icon and the board reset with the same 5 dots. That seems to be the intended flow (collect key → next round). Let's continue.
